quarterly_data.quarter: Apple press release: Apple announces American Manufacturing Program partners for (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: American Manufacturing Program: Apple will commit up to $100 million over the next three years with Perryman Company, a Pennsylvania titanium producer supplying titanium (minimum 80 percent recycled content) for products such as iPhone Duo, and is expanding its partnership with Qnity Electronics, which will produce advanced films for the variable aperture camera of iPhone 18 Pro; nearly 100 components in iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro are produced by American companies; by the end of 2026 all cover glass for iPhone and Apple Watch sold worldwide will be produced at Corning's Harrodsburg, Kentucky facility; the Houston facility that builds Apple's advanced AI servers will begin manufacturing Mac mini this year.
quarterly_data.figure: up to $100 million over three years with Perryman; nearly 100 U.S.-made components
